figures.caption: Figure 17: Region Analysis. Skill-based forensic analysis focusing on localized scene regions and object-level details to identify potential inconsistencies in local structures, textures, and semantic compositions.

Figure 18: Frequency Consistency. Skill-based forensic analysis that incorporates frequency-spectrum analysis models to examine whether the image exhibits realistic frequency distributions and spectral consistency patterns.

Figure 13: Common Sense. Skill-based forensic reasoning based on commonsense consistency analysis, evaluating whether scene content, object relationships, and semantic interactions conform to real-world expectations and everyday human cognition.

Table 3: Performance on GenImage. ClueAegis achieves the best overall performance on the GenImage benchmark, surpassing existing methods by 0.67% in accuracy and demonstrating strong generalization capability on conventional synthetic image detection settings.
Table 2: Generalization on AIGI-Now. ClueAegis achieves the best overall performance in terms of accuracy, demonstrating superior generalization capability across advanced generative models.

Figure 21: Transformation Consistency. Skill-based forensic analysis that evaluates robustness under geometric rotation and color transformations, examining whether structural layout and chromatic relationships remain consistent and physically plausible after such changes.

Figure 14: Functional Inconsistency. Skill-based forensic reasoning based on functional consistency analysis, evaluating whether objects and scene components conform to realistic functionalities and real-world usage relationships.
Figure 7: Performance across different visual content types.

Figure 10: Lighting Consistency. Skill-based forensic reasoning based on illumination consistency analysis. External lighting analysis models are further incorporated to assist the examination of spatial light directions and shadow relationships.

Figure 15: OCR Consistency. Skill-based forensic reasoning based on textual consistency analysis. External OCR models are further incorporated to examine recognized text content, typography, and semantic alignment consistency.
Figure 20: Pixel Consistency. Skill-based forensic analysis that leverages pixel-level forensic models to examine local pixel distributions, texture continuity, and low-level visual inconsistencies.
Figure 6: Visualization of ClueAegis-Bench. Representative image samples from different skill-driven forensic subspaces with diverse visual contents and synthetic distributions.
Figure 5: Results on additional benchmarks.
Figure 3: Overview of ClueAegis. A two-stage pipeline consisting of System 1 (heuristic) and System 2 (reasoning).

Figure 11: Shadow Consistency. Skill-based forensic reasoning based on shadow consistency analysis. External shadow extraction and object segmentation models are further incorporated to examine the spatial coherence among objects, illumination, and projected shadows.

Figure 9: Prompt template for Lighting Consistency. The prompt includes input images, auxiliary DeepLSDbased lighting analysis, and a structured reasoning checklist for real-vs-synthetic classification.

Figure 19: Frequency Consistency. Skill-based forensic analysis that incorporates frequency-spectrum analysis models to examine whether the image exhibits realistic frequency distributions and spectral consistency patterns.

Figure 16: Human Anatomy. Skill-based forensic analysis that evaluates whether human body structures, anatomical proportions, and articulation relationships conform to realistic human anatomy principles.
Figure 12: Physical Consistency. Skill-based forensic reasoning from a physical perspective, analyzing whether image content conforms to real-world physical laws and spatial interaction constraints.
